title: UK REF 2014 Analysis Data and R Script
author: Lloyd Balbuena
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.t3eeqje

steps.title: Load Data
steps.instruction: Load the required data files into the R environment.

substeps.instruction: Load the RData file (balbuena_ref.rdata) using the command Session | Load Workspace.
Alternatively, import the Stata (balbuena_ref_2014.dta) or Excel (balbuena_ref_2014.csv) files using the Part I section of the syntax file.

steps.title: Execute Analysis Commands
steps.instruction: Run the commands in the syntax file to replicate the analysis.

substeps.instruction: Run commands line by line or select specific parts for replication.
To replicate only the BART analysis, proceed directly to Part 3 after loading the data.
